verdict.rationale: An AI gateway with usage and observability dashboards could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on its own data, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows standard dashboards (usage metrics, request logs, spend monitoring, CSV/JSON export) and automatic provider routing. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
